articles.title: A Robot Hand Like Thing Can Walk, Type and Play a Game
articles.summary: Engineers built a spooky robot hand inspired by Thing from The Addams Family. It balances on its fingertips, walks on different surfaces and can type on a keyboard.

articles.title: Electronic Music Pioneer Suzanne Ciani, 80, Finds an Audience at Last
articles.summary: Suzanne Ciani helped shape electronic music and even created Coca-Cola's "pop & pour" sound. At 80, she says young people finally understand what she began.

articles.title: Stray Kids Reportedly Join BTS in Skipping Grammy Submissions
articles.summary: Billboard reports that K-pop group Stray Kids will skip the Grammy process, like BTS. The Grammys say a new Asian pop category is meant to include more artists, not divide them.
